task.title: Revert or Reset Commits
task.shortdesc: Undo commits, either by adding an inverse commit (revert) or by moving the branch pointer back (reset).

step.cmd: In the view, right-click the commit and choose the desired action.

choices.choice: - Adds a new commit that undoes the selected one. This is safe for commits you have already shared, because it does not rewrite history.
- Moves the current branch back to the selected commit. Use this with care, and only on commits you have not shared.
